uncertainty: Pilot cell: five PHP paths verified, react/dns, daverandom/libdns, pear/net_dns2, utopia-php/dns and jdwx/dns-query, ranked by Packagist total downloads. daverandom/libdns's php-fuzzer blocker (the interceptor rewrite breaks one class constant) is resolved by loading that single class file unmodified in the fuzz entry only; amphp/dns, spatie/dns and remotelyliving/php-dns are excluded as resolvers or wrappers. Round-2 checks: purplepixie/phpdns parses only inside its socket client; mikepultz/netdns2 is the same repository as pear/net_dns2 (identical v2.0.7 commit) and is not counted twice; the other new Packagist hits are resolvers, format adapters over LibDNS, Net_DNS2 1.x forks or unreleased packages. jdwx/dns-query is a Net_DNS2 1.x fork that shares 6.0% of its distinct source lines with pear/net_dns2 2.x; yswery/dns remains a lead. react/dns, daverandom/libdns and utopia-php/dns drop the Z, AD and CD bits (z reported as 0). Each verified path parses the two valid controls (a query and a response with compressed CNAME/A/AAAA/MX answers) to the hand-written oracle summary, has library source coverage and stable AFL++ feedback that differs between the controls. Two valid controls do not establish EDNS0, DNSSEC, TXT, authority/additional or malformed-input behaviour. Package-level adoption metrics include non-DNS use; the remaining leads are unverified, and the cell is not a definitive top ten.
